name: Monstrous Onslaught
oracle_text: Monstrous Onslaught deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control as you cast this spell.
blocked_sentences: Monstrous Onslaught deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control as you cast this spell.

needs.what: a spell-level damage effect that divides a computed total among any number of target creatures as the caster chooses, with the division announced on casting (601.2d) and each target assigned at least 1
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The damage op carries amount/objects/target but no division option, so it would deal the full X to every target; distribute_counters is the only dividing op, it places counters rather than damage, and the notes restrict it to activated abilities with a printed amount

needs.what: a value computed as the spell is cast and fixed for resolution: the greatest power among creatures you control at cast time (needed anyway because the division of X is announced on casting)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: extreme_value / max over power can read the greatest power, but only at resolution; nothing in value_keys snapshots a board characteristic at cast time, and snapshot works on targets, not on the caster's board when the spell was cast
